text:
Aisha R: Heads-up: release/2026-03-21 promo blocked — CI shows `integration-system` failing consistently (3/3) with connection pool saturation. https://ci.redwood.example/runs/3011229
Miguel Soto: I pulled the logs, looks like `pg` errors with `ConnectionTimeoutError` and then the test harness kills a bunch of workers. Started after the bundler bump yesterday.
Tina M: Snapshot of failure: `ActiveRecord::ConnectionTimeoutError: timeout waiting for connection` and stack traces pointing into `connection_pool` internals.
DeployBot: Promotion paused for release/2026-03-21: failing checks (integration-system x3). To override, use `/deploy promote --force` after manual approval.
Jared K: Do we have a last-known-good artifact to fall back to? Change window starts in 25m and we should avoid missing it.
Miguel Soto: Last good is `registry.redwood/inference:2026-03-20-rc2 (sha256:4d2f7c...)`. Local repro: bundle with connection_pool 2.0.0 causes short-lived connection leaks. v1.9.7 seems fine.
Aisha R: Suggested plan: 1) promote rc2 to staging to meet the change window; 2) open a short-lived lockfile pin for connection_pool to 1.9.7 and run full CI; 3) if passes twice, promote new image and update release notes.
Tina M: +1. Also we should add a note to the release docs mentioning temporary pin and follow-up security check.
DeployBot: Promotion request queued: promote sha256:4d2f7c... -> staging. Canary will run smoke suite.
Oncall Bot: Paging SRE @jared-k for DB pool investigation.
Jared K: I'll check connection pool settings and whether tuning the pool size temporarily avoids the issue while we patch.
Miguel Soto: I've opened PR to pin connection_pool: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6139 — includes a test that reproduces the leak locally.
Aisha R: Can someone kick the pinned-build after the PR merges? We need two consecutive green integration-system runs before swapping images.
Tina M: Kicking off a manual build now./cc @deploybot to watch for new artifact.
DeployBot: Canary started for promoted image. Smoke tests passed. Waiting for full integration-system runs on the pinned build.
Miguel Soto: Build triggered by PR merge completed, integration-system run #1 passed. Re-running to satisfy gating policy.
Aisha R: If the upgraded connection_pool is a security release, we need an exceptions call; otherwise prefer to block upgrade until we have a vetted plan.
Jared K: Confirmed: no critical CVE in 2.0.0 that mandates immediate upgrade. We'll schedule a deeper run on perf infra to validate before upgrading.
Tina M: Integration-system run #2 passed. Ready to swap images and proceed with change window. I'll update release-notes draft: "Temporarily pinned connection_pool to 1.9.7 after intermittent DB pool exhaustion observed in CI; upgrade deferred pending infra validation."
DeployBot: Promotion complete: staging now running sha256:...; canary green; release state: pinned until post-release verification.
Aisha R: Thanks all. I'll update the release ticket (RLD-2026-031) with the rollback + pin details and assign the follow-up to Miguel to run extended perf tests.
Miguel Soto: Will take it and run overnight regressions on perf infra.
Aisha R: Closing thread unless anyone objects. :+1:
